market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $75,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$82k on May 6 2026; May low so far is $78-79k per coverage. Reaching $75k requires a further -8.5% drop in remaining 25 days. Possible if oil/risk-off cascade resumes but BTC has shown $79k support multiple times this month.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether US-Iran deal collapses driving risk-off and crypto liquidation
